why: Advice 2 correctly derives break-even CPC from the given numbers, and it ties go/no-go criteria to the asker's own allowable CPA after pixel verification. Advice 1 adds useful domain insight on ad-traffic CVR and pre- vs post-arrival targeting, but it invents a 50/50 probability and assumed margins, and its stop threshold (¥15k) exceeds its own allowable CPA (¥12k).
